{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Implement Azure Event Hubs support as Spring-compatible source and sink modules using the supported Azure Java client library, with configurable namespace, credentials, event hub name, consumer group, batching, and checkpoint behavior.",
    "Implement IPython Notebook integration through a small HTTP-based integration layer compatible with the existing Spring XD runtime, rather than embedding a Python interpreter in the Java process.",
    "Preserve prior Spring XD installation directories and files by copying or migrating them to a versioned location while retaining reusable servers.yml configuration and avoiding destructive in-place upgrades.",
    "Implement direct module binding as an alternate execution path that connects compatible module inputs and outputs in-process, bypassing messaging middleware while preserving lifecycle, type-conversion, and error-handling contracts.",
    "Expose the xd-admin functionality through Spring MVC REST controllers and service interfaces, with CRUD endpoints for stream and batch-pipeline definitions.",
    "Provide ModuleRegistry test stubs using an in-memory implementation and injectable interfaces so stream and registry API tests do not require a deployed module registry.",
    "Move spring-cloud-stream-modules into the spring-cloud repository using a multi-module build arrangement, preserving public module APIs and adapting package, dependency, and publication configuration as required.",
    "Implement the in-memory stream definition repository behind the existing repository abstraction, with process-local storage and no persistence across application executions.",
    "Use the existing project build, dependency-management, coding, logging, configuration, and test conventions wherever they are available.",
    "Add automated unit, integration, and compatibility tests for each feature, with focused end-to-end tests for Azure Event Hubs, REST operations, direct binding, and repository behavior."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The increment is implemented in an existing Spring XD, Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Cloud Data Flow, or related codebase with usable extension points; it is not a greenfield implementation.",
    "Requirements are interpreted as eight related feature increments, one for each user story, and existing product terminology and APIs are available in the source repositories.",
    "Azure credentials and an Event Hubs test environment are available for integration testing; provisioning cloud infrastructure is outside this estimate.",
    "The required Azure behavior is standard event production and consumption, not advanced features such as geo-disaster recovery, capture, schema registry integration, or exactly-once processing.",
    "IPython Notebook integration means submitting or executing supported notebook computations and exchanging results through an existing or newly provided HTTP integration endpoint; full Jupyter kernel management and rich UI development are excluded.",
    "The upgrade feature targets the currently supported installation layout and servers.yml format; migration across arbitrary historical versions is excluded.",
    "Direct binding is limited to modules with compatible contracts and does not require redesigning all existing modules or eliminating messaging middleware globally.",
    "The REST API scope is foundational CRUD support for stream and batch-pipeline definitions, including validation and standard error responses; authentication, authorization, pagination, and production-grade API versioning are excluded unless already provided by the codebase.",
    "ModuleRegistry stubs only need to support the interactions required by mock stream tests and do not need to emulate a complete remote registry or module artifact repository.",
    "Moving modules between repositories includes source relocation, build and dependency updates, package/publication adjustments, and regression tests, but not a large-scale redesign of the modules.",
    "The in-memory repository is process-local, thread-safe for normal application use, and intentionally non-persistent.",
    "One developer performs implementation, testing, documentation, code review preparation, and defect correction; estimates are work-hours and exclude elapsed calendar time."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Increment analysis and technical design",
      "activity_description": "Inspect the existing repositories and extension points, map each user story to affected components, define interfaces, configuration properties, compatibility constraints, and an implementation/test plan.",
      "most_likely_effort": 24
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Azure Event Hubs read/write integration",
      "activity_description": "Implement configurable Event Hubs producer and consumer modules, credential and connection configuration, event conversion, lifecycle handling, error behavior, and unit and integration tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 72
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "IPython Notebook integration",
      "activity_description": "Implement the notebook communication layer, request and result handling, configuration, runtime integration, failure handling, and tests using representative interactive computations.",
      "most_likely_effort": 64
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "Backward-compatible installation upgrade support",
      "activity_description": "Implement preservation and migration of prior installation directories and files, retain reusable servers.yml configuration, handle conflicts and reruns, and add upgrade regression tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 40
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "Direct module binding",
      "activity_description": "Add the direct-binding execution path, module compatibility checks, in-process input/output connection, lifecycle management, conversion and error propagation, configuration, and performance-oriented tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 80
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "xd-admin REST API foundation",
      "activity_description": "Create REST controller, service, DTO, validation, serialization, error-response, and routing foundations, then implement CRUD operations for streaming and batch-pipeline definitions with endpoint tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 96
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "ModuleRegistry test stubs",
      "activity_description": "Define or adapt registry interfaces and implement injectable in-memory stubs supporting module lookup and registration interactions needed to construct mock streams, with unit tests.",
      "most_likely_effort": 40
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "Move spring-cloud-stream-modules between repositories",
      "activity_description": "Relocate module source and tests, update build aggregation, dependencies, package and publication metadata, adapt references, and verify that the moved modules remain usable externally.",
      "most_likely_effort": 56
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "In-memory stream definition repository",
      "activity_description": "Implement the repository abstraction with process-local storage, CRUD behavior, validation, lifecycle integration, concurrency handling, and tests confirming the absence of persistence between executions.",
      "most_likely_effort": 32
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Cross-feature build and compatibility integration",
      "activity_description": "Resolve dependency and API compatibility issues across the affected Spring modules, update configuration and packaging, run supported JDK/build profiles, and address integration defects discovered during assembly.",
      "most_likely_effort": 24
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A11",
      "activity_name": "End-to-end and regression testing",
      "activity_description": "Create and execute cross-component tests covering REST-driven CRUD flows, registry-backed mock streams, direct binding, in-memory definitions, upgrade behavior, and available Azure and notebook integration environments.",
      "most_likely_effort": 64
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A12",
      "activity_name": "Documentation and operational configuration",
      "activity_description": "Document configuration, deployment and upgrade procedures, REST usage, direct-binding limitations, Azure prerequisites, notebook integration, repository behavior, and examples for developers and operators.",
      "most_likely_effort": 24
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A13",
      "activity_name": "Final defect correction and delivery preparation",
      "activity_description": "Perform final code review preparation, static analysis cleanup, targeted defect fixes, test stabilization, changelog updates, and preparation of the deliverable for integration into the product branches.",
      "most_likely_effort": 40
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 656
  }
}

Expose the xd-admin functionality through Spring MVC REST controllers and service interfaces, with CRUD endpoints for stream and batch-pipeline definitions.
Provide ModuleRegistry test stubs using an in-memory implementation and injectable interfaces so stream and registry API tests do not require a deployed module registry.

Move spring-cloud-stream-modules into the spring-cloud repository using a multi-module build arrangement, preserving public module APIs and adapting package, dependency, and publication configuration as required.
Implement the in-memory stream definition repository behind the existing repository abstraction, with process-local storage and no persistence across application executions.
Use the existing project build, dependency-management, coding, logging, configuration, and test conventions wherever they are available.
Add automated unit, integration, and compatibility tests for each feature, with focused end-to-end tests for Azure Event Hubs, REST operations, direct binding, and repository behavior.

The REST API scope is foundational CRUD support for stream and batch-pipeline definitions, including validation and standard error responses; authentication, authorization, pagination, and production-grade API versioning are excluded unless already provided by the codebase.
ModuleRegistry stubs only need to support the interactions required by mock stream tests and do not need to emulate a complete remote registry or module artifact repository.
Moving modules between repositories includes source relocation, build and dependency updates, package/publication adjustments, and regression tests, but not a large-scale redesign of the modules.

One developer performs implementation, testing, documentation, code review preparation, and defect correction; estimates are work-hours and exclude elapsed calendar time.
